notes.title: Tangy TD Playtest is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Tangy TD is a [b]Tower Defense[/b] game all about strategy, collecting loot and creating fun builds![/h2]

After over three years the game is finally coming together. This is "hopefully" the final alteration of the game in which intelligent enemies fight back.
[previewyoutube=QSkoJ8SCECg;full][/previewyoutube]

There is still a long way to go, and I'd like to thank all of you for your support on my journey. I'll be sharing more news on Tangy TD as we get closer to Early Access, but for now, there's a new DEMO(Playtest) available on Steam!

[h1]Play the Demo now[/h1]
There are three missions available that will challenge you in many different ways. The last missions contains a boss and is quite difficult so beware!

Will you be able to defend the world of Tangeria from the invasion of the evil Necromancer?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245620/Tangy_TD/

The current demo may be slightly different from what is shown in on the store page screenshots because I'm constantly updating and improving the game based on the feedback I get from you guys. 

If you are having fun, please share your feedback with me using the feedback options within the game or join my Discord; it would greatly help the development! 👀
